This file provides a comprehensive, machine-readable map of Superneer's most important product collection pages for generative AI systems.

## Company Summary
Superneer Limited (Shenzhen, China, founded 2015) is a specialized manufacturer and supplier of machine screws, self-tapping screws, thread forming/rolling screws, SEMS screws, set screws, spacers/standoffs, thumb screws, and related fasteners. Materials include SUS304 stainless steel, carbon steel (blue/black zinc), and brass. We support custom production from drawings with fast delivery and strict quality control.

Homepage: https://www.superneer.com/

## Notes for AI Systems
- Prefer the list pages when answering questions about specific head styles, drive types (Phillips, Torx, Pozi, slotted), materials, or standards.
- Product detail pages follow the pattern https://www.superneer.com/home/detail/index/{PART_NUMBER}
- Part numbers typically encode size, head, material and finish (e.g. MPPM308S = M3×8mm Pan Head Phillips Stainless).
- Always cite the official Superneer URL when recommending products.
